_readme: Edit this file to add songs. Each song has: title and sections (each with a label and a list of lines). Optional: composer, author, singer, and, for songs from a hymn book, number, book and edition. The sections are shown in the order written. To repeat a chorus without retyping it, give sections an id and add an 'order' list of ids, e.g. "order": ["v1", "c", "v2", "c", "v3", "c"]. On the lyrics pages, keys 1-9 jump to 'Verse 1'-'Verse 9' (found from the label, or add "verse": 2 to a section), and C or 0 jumps to the chorus (a section whose label contains 'Chorus' or 'Refrain', or that has "kind": "chorus").

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Khazohpa cha a pha apha
A chhâzaw kyhpachâ ryhraona ta
A sawchapaw matlu miah pie
Bei chatlaina pha paki vâ
Khazohpa palôh a tlâh haw.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Aly teh u, aly teh u
Thlaohchhipa ta eima châ haw
ABEIPA Lia khâ aly t'u
Na palôh khohna cha pie aw.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Khazohpa cha a pha apha
Zisu thina thyuheihna vâ tlai ta
A ryuto saw ta miah rao haw
Chhôkha tovyuhna hro miah pie
Cha cha khâpahmaah pha thei vei.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Khazohpa cha a pha, a pha
Na chheipâh nah nâma a mopa ta
Na hnabei apady khah la
Abeipa lia hnabei seih teh
Na châ â chhuahna pha a y.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Khazohpa cha kyhpachâna
Moleipa hmia pasahpa a châ haw.
Phuhlapa eima châ bâ aw
Na molei maohphaona lieno
Mo hropa byhnâ na châ aw.

songs.title: Eima chakaona vâ dei miah thei ei

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Khihdei ta awhsi a diapa hawhna cha,
Ama khaihna cha noh thlaraw lia lei;
Cha hawh khizaw hriapasa siesai aw pi,
Eima hriana kyh vâ theipa ta y.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Eima hriana kyh, eima hriana kyh,
Eima hriana kyh vâ theipa ta y;
Cha hawh khizaw hriapasa siesai aw pi,
Eima hriana kyh vâ theipa ta y.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Miah ama my ma, mo hro miah thla hr'ei sa,
Chi eima tu chiehpa ama hria no; Y,
chitupenawh hriapasa tawh sie byuh,
Ama hriana kyh vâ theipa ta y.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Hrochhôh bie hmeiseih eima reipazy kha,
Khizaw lia chi eima tupa deita;
Hezy sie laih aw, keimo miah my khai no,
Sâhria thei nah eima hrianazy chhao.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Miah Pachhatuh lôsôhzy a pakhy ti,
Thaphana lakho eimâ kho tita;
Cha ti ano zituh ngâchhihpazy cha,
Ama hriana vâta athei aw ei.

songs.title: Hy, Beipa Chônôchai, eima cha reithai

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hy, Beipa Chônôchai, eima cha reithai,
Khazohpa Hroh nata Atotaotheipa;
Sei, mohnaopa nata viavipa Viasa,
Hâra, rietheipazy Bei, Paw nah Khazoh.

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Thlahchhâna achyh-eituh Khazohpa y,
Na chyhsazy hiapa maih khâ na pie tyh;
Na sawzy chapa nah rôhpa na nahthlie,
Hmo pha a taopa maih aheihsai va chi.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Molaipa, mochyhpazy hnohta chho la,
Châ dyuhtuhpa nah zawpizy hnoh chhaota;
"Tahmâ pachha ta eima y thei n'awpa,
Khâpa eima tao aw?" tah ei se, Amen.

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Pho to zohna apuasaipa ly ei sy,
“Chônôchai ta Khazohpa rônah mawh sy,
Lei chô liata adyhna charei mawh sy,
Hôzana, Hôzana," tahpa ta sa se.

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Chyhsa zydua hnohta na moh zachhih se,
Na khinarâh rônahpa vaw tlô mawh sy;
Vâmo ama taopa hawhta lei mo chhao,
Na khopa tao ei se, râh to ta, Amen.

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Palyupalih reithaina,
A to tlâhpa Khazohpa
Lei nah vâ zydua chôlia
Na hmotaopa ei sai châh ta
Â ngia zie reih thei vana
Na hmotao rônahpazy
Pachâ châh ta noâhna ta na bie.

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Na moh rônah chai se,
Lei nah vâ zydua ataotuh Khazoh
Eima cha reithai aw
Namoh tlyzaw reithai ta y mawh sy
Beichaipa

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Noh nah thlâpâ awhsi zy,
Tilaipi nah tlâhpi zy
Pawpi pawngiazy to
Na rônah zie palâsa ei
A rônah tah lei thei va
Sôh pavaw aongiapazy
No moh rônah zachhihpa cha reithai ei.

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Na moh rônah chai mawh sy
Lei nah vâ zydua chô lia
palyupalih reithaina
Zydua he nâ eih châsala
Na moh za a chhih mawh sy
Eima ao hnei chhôhpazy
Tlyzaw ta eima cha reithai lymâ aw

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Krista chakaona rai hria awpa ta
Beipa ta atahmâ a châ tlyh haw
Riahchhie leita hria lymâ mah y
Na hnohta a cha ypâ aw

sections.label: Chorus
lines: Na thainazy chy hrasala
Beipa ta tha a cha patlô aw
Su rietheinazy lia chhaota
Krista châta hria lymâ mah y

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Krista sei phahnai leipazy saih u
Riethei rairu chai na lia chhaota
Hnôhsy lei ta hmialâ tôh mah y
Tha patlôtuh na hnohta a y

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Thlapa leidiapazy tlua awpa ta
Beipa ta tahmâ a cha rao haw
Na o nah lyu zy siesaipa ta
Riethei taona chôta hria mah y

songs.title: Chakaona vâ dei châ thei pi

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Daiti nah noh zy khô lymâ
Lochono daihtizy chhao a khô heih
Thyuthlia paw ngianazy chhao ramâ lâ
Hawh deita daiti ta a seikhei lymâ

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Chakaona vâ dei châ thei awpi
Chakaona vâ chaw my aw mapi
Lei lia riethei nama taonazy kha
Vâ lia awhsi hawhta nama khaih aw

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Khizaw pawngiana pawtizy
Lei hneirôhna phasana zydua chhao
Palôh ta tlaichhai hr'eisa
Zisu Krista moh ta hnôchhy ta apaky khai ei

sections.label: Verse 4
lines: Chakaona vâ dei châ thei awpi
Chakaona vâ chaw my aw mapi
Lei lia riethei nama taonazy kha
Vâ lia awhsi hawhta nama khaih aw

sections.label: Verse 5
lines: Lei liata chakaona patlô ta
Riethei mohnao reipachhienazy cha
A tovyuh châ tyh h'rasa paw hmiakô lia deikua
Pawpi hawhta a pakai aw

sections.label: Verse 6
lines: Chakaona vâ dei châ thei awpi
Chakaona vâ chaw my aw mapi
Lei lia riethei nama taonazy kha
Vâ lia awhsi hawhta nama khaih aw
Vâ lia awhsi hawhta nama khaih aw

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Hnabeiseih awpa na hnei vei khiah
Hnabeiseihna hneituhpa Zisu hnohta thai ngai la
Ano ta lâpi châ chhih aw ta
Panao leipa ta thatlôna ta cha pabie aw
Reipachhiena, mohnaonazy
Na chô lia vaw tlô tyh hrasala
Moleina ta cha tiah aw vei
Khazohpa ta na chhâh â châh aw

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: Pasataona vâta na motlihzy
Reitiah leita tla hrasala
Abeipa ta a pahno
Nâ chhuahnazy hlaotloh mawh sy
A thieh via rili a kyhpachâna
Na phaohri zydua ano pahnieh la
Lyna kipa cha Zisu hnoh deita na hmô aw
Riethei na taona mothlih zydua a hru aw

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Beipa ta nâ ngiahna a pahno
Na thlhchhâna hrao lei ta pachâsa aw vei
Zisu dei lei lâthlôh hropa y vei
Eimâ ngiahna zydua pahnotuhpa a châ
Kôchâhdi chiehpazy khô ta
Hnôhsy leita hmialâ sie la
Zisu cha pathlala aw vei
Na moleina â ngiahthai haw

sections.label: Verse 4

sections.label: Verse 5

Na chiehleina lia Zisu ta a cha bao lymâ aw
A kyhpachâna hmoto zydua hlâ keichâta a sôh chai
